DARV.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-1.char: [jitter]DARV![/jitter] Mine dearest old friend! Art thou selling those dreadful wares still?
DARV.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-2.ancie: ...Will you leave if I give ya something?
DARV.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.1-0r.anci: Don't ya have somewhere to be?
DARV.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-0.char: If it be desired, I shall supplant thine drab, itchy robe for something of a finer standard.
DARV.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-1.char: Or... lo, hast thou coffers run dry? Must I provide... a [sine]'Freebie'?[/sine] For a [sine]'Friendie'???[/sine]
NEOW.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-0.char: Hark, giant one! Wilt thou assist in mine quest to locate the Architect?
NEOW.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-2.char: Thou darest cast thine doubt upon me? No matter! (I shall clandestinely purloin thine relic and depart with haste...)
NEOW.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.1-1r.char: Thine attitude offends me and thy breath reeketh of fishe.
NEOW.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-0r.char: I requireth thy boon once more, blubbery creature!
NEOW.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.4-0r.char: That slobbering pillock Architect hast the [jitter]GALL[/jitter] to deny mine rightful reward?
Oh? And who are you, dear?
A dame of such beauty and superb fashion... [jitter]Remembereth me not?[/jitter]
[sine]...I g-gaveth thou... uh... a coat. Free of charge.[/sine]
Ah, my wonderful fur coat! How rude of me to forget!
Let me repay your kindness.
NONUPEIPE.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.1-0r:
One so lovely as you, my dear, deserveth the moon, the stars... mine own heart.
Perchance?
NONUPEIPE.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.1-1r: ...I'm sure you have places to be.
NONUPEIPE.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-0r:
Hark! Thine elegance dazzles me so. Mine heart sings for the gentleness of thy lips!
Haveth thou a... [sine]reward[/sine] for mine efforts thus far...?
NONUPEIPE.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-1r: Of course! Take one of these.
NONUPEIPE.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.3-0r: Your fabrics are the talk of the palace. Shall we make an exchange?
OROBAS.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-0.anc: Woah!!! Colorful coat! Shiny mask! Me want see.
OROBAS.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.1-0r.ch: O, great sea creature, hath thou exquisite trinkets for mine perusal?
OROBAS.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-1.cha: I am starting to liketh thou, fishy organisme!
OROBAS.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.3-0r.ch: Orobas! A sight for mine sore eyes! Whatever curios hath thou for me?
PAEL.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-0.ancie: [thinky_dots]The Tailor, is it? Word of your reputation has climbed the Spire already.[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-1.char: What business is this of yours? Thou weareth no garments at all!
PAEL.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-2.ancie: [thinky_dots]Let me know when you find a coat in dragon size.[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.1-0r.char: Thine relics may be of great use... but why, asketh I, art they so [jitter]sticky?[/jitter]
PAEL.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.1-1r.anci: [thinky_dots]You wish to keep your hands clean? Abandon your quest, then.[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-0r.anci: [thinky_dots]Do not let your ego guide you. Our dreams speak our truth...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.3-0r.char:
The monster of pudding sleepeth soundly.
Let me be quiet, lest I suffer another lecture...
TANX.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-1r.char: Oh, insipid creature! Thou art lacking in imagination!
TANX.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-2r.anci: YOU ARE LACKING IN WEAPONS!!! TAKE ONE!
TANX.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-1.char: [i][font_size=22]The Tailor stands back and sends his minions after Tanx.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-3.char: And scratcheth mine new coat? [jitter]NEVER,[/jitter] I say!
TANX.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-4.ancie: AFRAID? SO UNMIGHTY!!! YOU'LL NEED A WEAPON!
TANX.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.3-0r.char: I beseech thee for a great weapon, freakish one!
TANX.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.4-0r.anci: DO MINIONS NEED WEAPONS!? AT LEAST LET THEM TAKE A SWING!!
VAKUU.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-0.anci: A new puppet, eh? One that's playing at being a puppetmaster...
VAKUU.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-1.char: I assure you, [jitter]cur[/jitter], that mine actions hath been inspired by a fury too righteous for thy demonic whisperings to impeach.
VAKUU.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-2.anci: One that thinks it's infallible, too. [sine]Exciting[/sine]!
VAKUU.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.1-0r.cha: Might I suggest wearing somethinge? Thy form disturbeth me so.
VAKUU.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.1-1r.anc: Keep your little fabrics to yourself. Let me give you something instead.
VAKUU.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-0r.anc: You won't make it with company so weak and disorganized. Have you considered thralldom?
VAKUU.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-1r.cha:
Oh, worm; these minions be not mere slaves to mine own whims!
Their life singeth to me, permeating the very materials of their creation.
VAKUU.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-2r.anc: But, you see, thralls are so much more [sine]fun![/sine] Let me show you.
VAKUU.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.3-0r.anc: Let's cut the talk and rip the [jitter]Architect[/jitter] to shreds.
Oh, the [jitter][b]stylist[/b][/jitter]! Please, sweetie, make yourself comfortable!
[jitter]Stylist!?[/jitter] Hath my name truly carry no measure of repute in this damnable Spire?
Alas...
Let us start over, [jitter][b]Tailor[/b][/jitter]... This'll calm your nerves!
TEZCATARA.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.1-1r:
[jitter][b]Ohh, my[/b][/jitter]...
You know, cookies aren't for rude boys!
TEZCATARA.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-0r:
I could use a soft, [jitter][b]toasty[/b][/jitter] blanket.
Up for a trade, Tailor?
ARCHITECT! I promised upon mine return. Now behold me, for I deliver consequences for thine misdeeds!
HARK! For I beseech thine penance, For this terrible thing which has been done,
For mine righteous judgement, so mote it be, Taketh no shape of sword or gun,
But a needle, to sew thine fate to mine own, For there is a debt to be repaid,
And I shall not rest upon mine laurels, Until this justice has been made.
Shall we discuss thine treacheries, Architect?
The finest garment of all, I hath made for thou... wherefore art mine compensation?
I don't recall such an exchange.
[jitter]ARCHITECT![/jitter] I return once more! Taste mine fury!
